text:
maria: quick thought 0 min sync: default new API keys to project-scoped. show the effective project in the keys table and require an explicit 'Org key' checkbox. aim: avoid surprise billing spikes across projects.

sam: makes sense. how do we handle legacy org-wide keys? several customers still use them for cross-project workflows.

maria: legacy keys remain org-scoped. new keys = project by default. routing precedence: (a) key.project if present, (b) key.scope == org -> route to org bucket, (c) if account opted-in to strict mode and ambiguous -> reject with 401.

irene: telemetry ask: add `effective_project` and `declared_scope` to access logs so we can compute cost delta pre/post migration. Also emit a metric `auth.effective_project_count` for monitoring.

leila: for quotas: preserve current org-bucket semantics for org keys for now (no split). Console should surface both org quota and per-project estimates. We can later add an "auto-split" option that uses a `X-Redwood-Project-Hint` header to attribute traffic.

sam: rollout approach? feature-flag new-key default behind FF and canary to opt-in orgs via support. enable full audit logs and a guardrail alert for unexpected quota exhaustion.

maria: rough rollout plan: 1) key metadata + console badge, 2) telemetry fields + dashboard panels, 3) FF canary for new-key behavior, 4) migration UI/tool for org admins with a simulation of historical billing impact.

irene: UI mock idea: key row shows small pill `proj: <id>` or `org`. clicking "simulate switch" runs a 30d backtest and shows estimated token delta and quota pressure. I'll put up mocks on the design board. :bar_chart:

leila: also add a diagnostic event when a single org key maps to one project > 90% of traffic over 7 days: `auth.migration_candidate`. that'll help identify low-risk migrations.

sam: monitoring: add a Prometheus alert for sudden shifts in `auth.effective_project_count` distribution per org (e.g., >30% shift in 1h). we saw silent project shifts before.

maria: good. SDKs should surface a helper to set the hint header. sample header for future auto-split mode:```
X-Redwood-Project-Hint: proj-012345
X-Redwood-Client: python-sdk/2.0.0
```

noah-bot: ticket create INF-1299: "auth: project-default keys + migration telemetry" linked to thread. assignees: maria, sam, irene, leila.

maria: action items: @sam - RFC covering routing precedence + quota semantics, @irene - telemetry schema + dashboard mocks, @leila - migration UX and simulation page copy. target: RFC + mocks in one week.

sam: I'll start the RFC now, will call out edgecases (webhooks, background workers).

irene: mock panels ETA EOD tomorrow. will include example Grafana query for `requests by effective_project`.

maria: thanks all. let's keep canary small and surfaced to support. :rocket:
